title: Zippy Slows Down
reason: Preserve the repeated Level B structure while turning the sequence into a clear mindfulness arc with standard dialogue and one coherent route.

pages.1: Zippy ran to the waterfall and back. Then he ran to the meadow and back.
pages.2: "Zippy!" called Sunny. "Where are you going?" "I do not know!" Zippy called as he ran past.
pages.3: Zippy ran past the picnic, the waterfall, and Sunny Hollow. He did not stop.
pages.4: At last, Zippy stopped. "Where am I?" he asked. He could not see Sunny Hollow.
pages.5: The valley was quiet. Zippy noticed small flowers under a wide blue sky.
pages.6: "This is nice," Zippy said. He sat beside the flowers and took a slow breath.
pages.7: Sunny found him. "I stopped to look at this flower," Zippy said. "I ran past it many times."
pages.8: Zippy walked home with Sunny. He went slowly enough to see the trees, clouds, and path.
